name: Last Observation Carried Forward
label: LOCF
description: Computes the last non-missing observed value within a partition, ordered by a time variable. The result carries forward the most recent non-missing value and is intended as input to M.Imputation.

inputs.description: Source value to carry forward (may contain missing values)
Grouping variables defining the carry-forward scope (typically subject, parameter)

levels.name: partition_level
levels.description: A level of the partition variable

inputs.description: Variable defining the temporal ordering within partition (e.g., AVISITN, ADY)

formula.defaultExpression: imputed_value := LOCF(value) OVER (partition ORDER BY time_order)
formula.notes: LOCF scans backwards in time_order within each partition and returns the most recent non-missing value. If no prior non-missing value exists, the result is missing.
